title.narrative: Promote Positive Coping Mechanisms and Resilience of Conflict Affected Women and Girls in Magumeri and Mobbar LGAs of Borno State.

description.narrative: ltpgtGZDI proposed project focused to address negative coping mechanisms of women and girls and other individual at risks in the targeted communities of intervention at Magumeri and Mobbar LGAs of Borno state through quality GBV response services that meet best practice and align with the global standards. The overall objective of the project is to enhance positive coping mechanisms and strengthen resilient factors of women and girls and other individual at risks thereby contributing to their overall well-being and saving their lives from the dire humanitarian situations exacerbated by food insecurity, poor economic situations, climate change among others. The project seeks to reach a total of 3,079 direct beneficiaries, and 15,395 indirect beneficiaries with various forms of GBV prevention, mitigation and response services. Notably, the project activities were designed around 2 strategic and complementary outcomes with corresponding 4 outputs (2 from each outcome). These outcomes are: lt/pgtltpgtltbgtOutcomlt/bgtltbgte 1lt/bgtltbgt lt/bgttarget to enhance the overall well-being of survivors of GBV, especially women and girls through access to live-saving and well-coordinated GBV response services that aligned with the GBV AoR strategic priorities and lean season plan. Under this outcome, GZDI focuses to reach 2460 direct women and girls and other individual at risk with with structured mental health and psycho-social support services and livelihood assistance including cash intervention through established equipped women and girls safe spaces and other community engagement activities. Further, 70 women and girls survivors of GBV are targeted to receive quality and comprehensive GBV case management services including facilitation of access to multisectoral assistance including food, health, legal, safety security among others. lt/pgtltpgtltbgtOutcome 2 lt/bgtof the project aimed to enable community-based structures, social welfare workforce from the ministry of women affairs and social development and other relevant GBV actors or partners to adequately be preventing, mitigating and responding to GBV incidents in their communities by themselves. GDZI under this outcome focused to strengthen local systems institutions including government institutions to adequately respond to GBV issues in the targeted communities of intervention. Community-based protection committees are targeted to be established strengthened, GBV partners actors, social welfare workforce and other relevant institution are targeted for robust GBV capacity strengthening. Further, 460 members of the community-based structures, staff, partners/actors and the wider community members are also targeted for strengthening on Prevention of Sexual Exploitation and Abuse, Gender and Disability Inclusion, Accountability to Affected Population and Protection Mainstreaming. lt/pgtltpgtMore pointedly, this proposed project aligned closely with the allocation strategy paper (the 2025 lean season allocation), the protection sector and GBV AoR strategic priorities, the lean season 2025 plan for the Northeast Nigeria and the Cadre Harmonize analysis 2025. lt/pgtltpgtA total of ltbgtUS$117,558.67 lt/bgt is requested under the protection sector (GBV AoR) to respond to the dire needs of the affected populations in Mobbar Magumeri LGAs through this strategic intervention. Further, GZDI is partnering with another woman-led and youth-led organization with active local presence in the targeted communities of intervention. This sub-IP (Gender Equality and Empowerment of Women and Children Initiative- GEEWCI) is strategic position locally connected within the targeted communities of intervention to bring immediate impact to the project. Both GZDI and GEEWCI have local presence in Magumeri Mobbar and have in-depth understanding of the context of the communities. Mobbar Magumeri are accessible and GZDI GEEWCI have taken cognizance of all potential risks that may hamper the project implementation and had put strategic mitigation measures in place to mitigate the risks. ltbrgtltbrgt lt/pgt
